Class AttendeeService

java.lang.Object
com.example.activityscheduler.attendee.service.AttendeeService
@Service @Transactional public class AttendeeService extends Object
Service class for managing Attendee entities. Provides business logic for attendee operations including CRUD operations, RSVP status management, and validation.
